purpose: Synthetic batch integration and OCR robustness comparison
integration_note: All three synthetic document cases (001–003) were processed in one batch. Both clean and scan-like image variants are run automatically as separate comparison conditions; no image-quality selector is required. The container photo is a separate model demonstration input and has not been verified as belonging to any synthetic document case.
safety_notice: Synthetic cases are for academic testing only. No cargo contents or operational safety decision are inferred.
